+"""A small in-memory inventory tracker for a shop."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+class InventoryError(Exception):
+    """Base error for inventory operations."""
+
+
+class ItemNotFoundError(InventoryError, KeyError):
+    """Raised when a SKU is not in the inventory."""
+
+
+class InsufficientStockError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when removing more units than are on hand."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Item:
+    """A stocked product with its SKU, display name, unit price, and count."""
+
+    sku: str
+    name: str
+    price: float
+    quantity: int = 0
+
+
+class Inventory:
+    """Tracks items by SKU with stock levels and prices."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._items: dict[str, Item] = {}
+
+    def add_item(
+        self, sku: str, name: str, price: float, quantity: int = 0
+    ) -> Item:
+        """Register a new item. Raises ValueError if the SKU already exists."""
+        if not sku:
+            raise ValueError("sku must be non-empty")
+        if sku in self._items:
+            raise ValueError(f"sku already exists: {sku!r}")
+        if price < 0:
+            raise ValueError("price must be non-negative")
+        if quantity < 0:
+            raise ValueError("quantity must be non-negative")
+        item = Item(sku=sku, name=name, price=price, quantity=quantity)
+        self._items[sku] = item
+        return item
+
+    def get(self, sku: str) -> Item:
+        try:
+            return self._items[sku]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise ItemNotFoundError(sku) from None
+
+    def remove_item(self, sku: str) -> None:
+        if sku not in self._items:
+            raise ItemNotFoundError(sku)
+        del self._items[sku]
+
+    def restock(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> int:
+        """Add units to stock. Returns the new quantity."""
+        if quantity <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("restock quantity must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        item.quantity += quantity
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def sell(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> int:
+        """Remove units from stock. Returns the new quantity."""
+        if quantity <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("sale quantity must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        if quantity > item.quantity:
+            raise InsufficientStockError(
+                f"only {item.quantity} of {sku!r} in stock, "
+                f"requested {quantity}"
+            )
+        item.quantity -= quantity
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def set_price(self, sku: str, price: float) -> None:
+        if price < 0:
+            raise ValueError("price must be non-negative")
+        self.get(sku).price = price
+
+    def low_stock(self, threshold: int) -> list[Item]:
+        """Items whose quantity is at or below the threshold, sorted by SKU."""
+        return sorted(
+            (i for i in self._items.values() if i.quantity <= threshold),
+            key=lambda i: i.sku,
+        )
+
+    def total_value(self) -> float:
+        """Sum of price * quantity across all items."""
+        return sum(i.price * i.quantity for i in self._items.values())
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._items)
+
+    def __contains__(self, sku: object) -> bool:
+        return sku in self._items

+"""A simple gradebook for teachers.
+
+Students are identified by string IDs. Assignments have a maximum point
+value and belong to a category (e.g. "homework", "exam") that carries a
+weight in the final grade. Scores are stored per (student, assignment).
+
+Final grades are computed as a weighted average of per-category averages,
+where each category average is the percentage of points earned across the
+assignments in that category that have a recorded score.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple
+
+DEFAULT_LETTER_SCALE: Tuple[Tuple[float, str], ...] = (
+    (90.0, "A"),
+    (80.0, "B"),
+    (70.0, "C"),
+    (60.0, "D"),
+    (0.0, "F"),
+)
+
+
+class GradebookError(Exception):
+    """Base class for gradebook errors."""
+
+
+class DuplicateError(GradebookError):
+    """Raised when adding a student, assignment, or category that exists."""
+
+
+class NotFoundError(GradebookError):
+    """Raised when referring to an unknown student, assignment, or category."""
+
+
+class InvalidScoreError(GradebookError):
+    """Raised when a score is negative, above the maximum, or not a number."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Assignment:
+    """A graded item worth ``max_points`` within a ``category``."""
+
+    id: str
+    name: str
+    max_points: float
+    category: str
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Gradebook:
+    """In-memory gradebook. Weights are relative and need not sum to 100."""
+
+    _categories: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    _students: Dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    _assignments: Dict[str, Assignment] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    _scores: Dict[Tuple[str, str], float] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    # ----- categories -------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_category(self, name: str, weight: float) -> None:
+        if not name:
+            raise ValueError("category name must be non-empty")
+        if weight < 0:
+            raise ValueError("category weight must be non-negative")
+        if name in self._categories:
+            raise DuplicateError(f"category already exists: {name}")
+        self._categories[name] = float(weight)
+
+    def categories(self) -> Dict[str, float]:
+        return dict(self._categories)
+
+    # ----- students ---------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_student(self, student_id: str, name: str) -> None:
+        if not student_id:
+            raise ValueError("student id must be non-empty")
+        if student_id in self._students:
+            raise DuplicateError(f"student already exists: {student_id}")
+        self._students[student_id] = name
+
+    def students(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
+        return dict(self._students)
+
+    # ----- assignments ------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_assignment(
+        self, assignment_id: str, name: str, max_points: float, category: str
+    ) -> None:
+        if not assignment_id:
+            raise ValueError("assignment id must be non-empty")
+        if max_points <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("max_points must be positive")
+        if assignment_id in self._assignments:
+            raise DuplicateError(f"assignment already exists: {assignment_id}")
+        if category not in self._categories:
+            raise NotFoundError(f"unknown category: {category}")
+        self._assignments[assignment_id] = Assignment(
+            assignment_id, name, float(max_points), category
+        )
+
+    def assignments(self) -> list[Assignment]:
+        return list(self._assignments.values())
+
+    # ----- scores -----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def record_score(
+        self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str, points: float
+    ) -> None:
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        assignment = self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        if isinstance(points, bool) or not isinstance(points, (int, float)):
+            raise InvalidScoreError("points must be a number")
+        if points < 0 or points > assignment.max_points:
+            raise InvalidScoreError(
+                f"points {points} out of range 0..{assignment.max_points}"
+            )
+        self._scores[(student_id, assignment_id)] = float(points)
+
+    def get_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str) -> Optional[float]:
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        return self._scores.get((student_id, assignment_id))
+
+    # ----- computations -----------------------------------------------
+
+    def category_average(
+        self, student_id: str, category: str
+    ) -> Optional[float]:
+        """Percent (0-100) earned across scored assignments in ``category``.
+
+        Args:
+            student_id: ID of an existing student.
+            category: Name of an existing category.
+
+        Returns:
+            The percent earned, or None if the student has no scores in
+            that category.
+
+        Raises:
+            NotFoundError: If the student or category is unknown.
+        """
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        if category not in self._categories:
+            raise NotFoundError(f"unknown category: {category}")
+        earned = 0.0
+        possible = 0.0
+        for a in self._assignments.values():
+            if a.category != category:
+                continue
+            score = self._scores.get((student_id, a.id))
+            if score is None:
+                continue
+            earned += score
+            possible += a.max_points
+        if possible == 0:
+            return None
+        return 100.0 * earned / possible
+
+    def final_grade(self, student_id: str) -> Optional[float]:
+        """Weighted average (0-100) across categories with scores.
+
+        Categories the student has no scores in are excluded and the weights
+        of the remaining categories are renormalized. Returns None if the
+        student has no scores at all.
+
+        Args:
+            student_id: ID of an existing student.
+
+        Returns:
+            The weighted percent (0-100), or None if nothing is scored.
+
+        Raises:
+            NotFoundError: If the student is unknown.
+        """
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        total_weight = 0.0
+        weighted = 0.0
+        for category, weight in self._categories.items():
+            avg = self.category_average(student_id, category)
+            if avg is None or weight == 0:
+                continue
+            total_weight += weight
+            weighted += weight * avg
+        if total_weight == 0:
+            return None
+        return weighted / total_weight
+
+    def letter_grade(
+        self,
+        student_id: str,
+        scale: Tuple[Tuple[float, str], ...] = DEFAULT_LETTER_SCALE,
+    ) -> Optional[str]:
+        grade = self.final_grade(student_id)
+        if grade is None:
+            return None
+        return letter_for(grade, scale)
+
+    def class_average(self) -> Optional[float]:
+        """Mean of final grades across all students who have a final grade."""
+        grades = [
+            g
+            for g in (self.final_grade(s) for s in self._students)
+            if g is not None
+        ]
+        if not grades:
+            return None
+        return sum(grades) / len(grades)
+
+    # ----- helpers ----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _require_student(self, student_id: str) -> None:
+        if student_id not in self._students:
+            raise NotFoundError(f"unknown student: {student_id}")
+
+    def _require_assignment(self, assignment_id: str) -> Assignment:
+        try:
+            return self._assignments[assignment_id]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise NotFoundError(
+                f"unknown assignment: {assignment_id}"
+            ) from None
+
+
+def letter_for(
+    grade: float, scale: Tuple[Tuple[float, str], ...] = DEFAULT_LETTER_SCALE
+) -> str:
+    """Map a numeric percent to a letter using ``scale``.
+
+    Args:
+        grade: Numeric percent to convert.
+        scale: Pairs of (minimum threshold, letter). Order does not matter.
+
+    Returns:
+        The letter for the highest threshold that ``grade`` meets.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: If no threshold is met.
+    """
+    for threshold, letter in sorted(scale, key=lambda t: t[0], reverse=True):
+        if grade >= threshold:
+            return letter
+    raise ValueError(f"no letter grade for {grade}")

+
+

+class Note:
+    """A single note."""
+
+    id: int
+    text: str
+    created: str  # ISO 8601, UTC
+
+
+class NoteStore:
+    """A collection of notes persisted to a JSON file.
+
+    The file is created on first write. A missing file is treated as empty.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        """Create a store backed by the file at ``path``."""
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        """Read all notes from disk; returns [] if the file does not exist."""
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: list[Note]) -> None:
+        """Atomically replace the store file with the given notes."""
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        # Write to a temp file then rename, so a crash never leaves a half-written store.
+        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=self.path.parent, prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                json.dump([asdict(n) for n in notes], fh, indent=2)
+            os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+        except BaseException:
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                os.unlink(tmp)
+            raise
+
+    def add(self, text: str) -> Note:
+        """Add a note with the given text and return it.
+
+        Args:
+            text: The note body; surrounding whitespace is stripped.
+
+        Returns:
+            The newly stored Note.
+
+        Raises:
+            ValueError: If the text is empty after stripping whitespace.
+        """
+        text = text.strip()
+        if not text:
+            raise ValueError("note text must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        note = Note(
+            id=next_id,
+            text=text,
+            created=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
+        )
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+

+        """Return all notes sorted by ID."""
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+

+        """Return the note with the given ID.
+
+        Args:
+            note_id: The ID of the note to fetch.
+
+        Returns:
+            The matching Note.
+
+        Raises:
+            NoteNotFoundError: If no note has this ID.
+        """
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+

+        """Remove and return the note with the given ID.
+
+        Args:
+            note_id: The ID of the note to delete.
+
+        Returns:
+            The deleted Note.
+
+        Raises:
+            NoteNotFoundError: If no note has this ID.
+        """

+        return [n for n in self.all_notes() if needle in n.text.lower()]

+"""A small in-memory inventory tracker for a shop."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+
+class InventoryError(Exception):
+    """Base class for inventory errors."""
+
+
+class UnknownItemError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when an SKU is not in the inventory."""
+
+
+class DuplicateItemError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when adding an SKU that already exists."""
+
+
+class InsufficientStockError(InventoryError):
+    """Raised when removing more units than are on hand."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Item:
+    """A stocked product with its unit price and units on hand."""
+
+    sku: str
+    name: str
+    unit_price: Decimal
+    quantity: int = 0
+
+
+class Inventory:
+    """Tracks items by SKU, supporting stock receipts, sales, and reporting."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._items: dict[str, Item] = {}
+
+    def add_item(
+        self,
+        sku: str,
+        name: str,
+        unit_price: Decimal | str | int,
+        quantity: int = 0,
+    ) -> Item:
+        if not sku:
+            raise ValueError("sku must be non-empty")
+        if sku in self._items:
+            raise DuplicateItemError(f"item {sku!r} already exists")
+        if quantity < 0:
+            raise ValueError("quantity must be non-negative")
+        price = Decimal(unit_price)
+        if price < 0:
+            raise ValueError("unit_price must be non-negative")
+        item = Item(sku=sku, name=name, unit_price=price, quantity=quantity)
+        self._items[sku] = item
+        return item
+
+    def get(self, sku: str) -> Item:
+        try:
+            return self._items[sku]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise UnknownItemError(f"no item with sku {sku!r}") from None
+
+    def __contains__(self, sku: object) -> bool:
+        return sku in self._items
+
+    def __len__(self) -> int:
+        return len(self._items)
+
+    def receive(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Add `amount` units to stock. Returns the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        item.quantity += amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def sell(self, sku: str, amount: int) -> int:
+        """Remove `amount` units from stock. Returns the new quantity."""
+        if amount <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("amount must be positive")
+        item = self.get(sku)
+        if amount > item.quantity:
+            raise InsufficientStockError(
+                f"cannot sell {amount} of {sku!r}; only {item.quantity} on hand"
+            )
+        item.quantity -= amount
+        return item.quantity
+
+    def low_stock(self, threshold: int) -> list[Item]:
+        """Items with quantity at or below `threshold`, sorted by SKU."""
+        return sorted(
+            (i for i in self._items.values() if i.quantity <= threshold),
+            key=lambda i: i.sku,
+        )
+
+    def total_value(self) -> Decimal:
+        return sum(
+            (i.unit_price * i.quantity for i in self._items.values()),
+            Decimal("0"),
+        )

+"""A simple gradebook for teachers.
+
+Students are identified by a unique string ID. Assignments have a name and a
+maximum number of points. Scores are recorded per student per assignment; a
+missing score (never recorded or recorded as None) is treated as not yet
+graded and is excluded from averages.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+
+DEFAULT_LETTER_SCALE: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = (
+    (90.0, "A"),
+    (80.0, "B"),
+    (70.0, "C"),
+    (60.0, "D"),
+    (0.0, "F"),
+)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Assignment:
+    name: str
+    max_points: float
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not self.name or not self.name.strip():
+            raise ValueError("assignment name must not be empty")
+        if self.max_points <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("max_points must be positive")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Student:
+    student_id: str
+    name: str
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Gradebook:
+    """Tracks students, assignments and scores for one class."""
+
+    letter_scale: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = DEFAULT_LETTER_SCALE
+    _students: dict[str, Student] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    _assignments: dict[str, Assignment] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    # scores[student_id][assignment_name] = points earned (or None if ungraded)
+    _scores: dict[str, dict[str, float | None]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    # --- roster -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_student(self, student_id: str, name: str) -> None:
+        if student_id in self._students:
+            raise ValueError(f"student {student_id!r} already exists")
+        if not name or not name.strip():
+            raise ValueError("student name must not be empty")
+        self._students[student_id] = Student(student_id, name)
+        self._scores[student_id] = {}
+
+    def remove_student(self, student_id: str) -> None:
+        self._get_student(student_id)
+        del self._students[student_id]
+        del self._scores[student_id]
+
+    def students(self) -> list[Student]:
+        return sorted(self._students.values(), key=lambda s: s.name)
+
+    # --- assignments ------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add_assignment(self, name: str, max_points: float) -> Assignment:
+        if name in self._assignments:
+            raise ValueError(f"assignment {name!r} already exists")
+        assignment = Assignment(name, max_points)
+        self._assignments[name] = assignment
+        return assignment
+
+    def remove_assignment(self, name: str) -> None:
+        if name not in self._assignments:
+            raise KeyError(f"no assignment named {name!r}")
+        del self._assignments[name]
+        for scores in self._scores.values():
+            scores.pop(name, None)
+
+    def assignments(self) -> list[Assignment]:
+        return list(self._assignments.values())
+
+    # --- scores -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def record_score(
+        self, student_id: str, assignment_name: str, points: float | None
+    ) -> None:
+        """Record points earned on an assignment. Pass None to clear a score."""
+        self._get_student(student_id)
+        assignment = self._get_assignment(assignment_name)
+        if points is not None:
+            if points < 0:
+                raise ValueError("points must not be negative")
+            if points > assignment.max_points:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"points {points} exceed max {assignment.max_points} for {assignment_name!r}"
+                )
+        self._scores[student_id][assignment_name] = points
+
+    def get_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_name: str) -> float | None:
+        self._get_student(student_id)
+        self._get_assignment(assignment_name)
+        return self._scores[student_id].get(assignment_name)
+
+    # --- calculations -----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def student_percentage(self, student_id: str) -> float | None:
+        """Points earned / points possible across graded assignments, as a percent.
+
+        Returns None if the student has no graded assignments yet.
+        """
+        self._get_student(student_id)
+        earned = 0.0
+        possible = 0.0
+        for name, points in self._scores[student_id].items():
+            if points is None:
+                continue
+            earned += points
+            possible += self._assignments[name].max_points
+        if possible == 0:
+            return None
+        return round(earned / possible * 100, 2)
+
+    def letter_grade(self, student_id: str) -> str | None:
+        pct = self.student_percentage(student_id)
+        if pct is None:
+            return None
+        for threshold, letter in self.letter_scale:
+            if pct >= threshold:
+                return letter
+        return self.letter_scale[-1][1]
+
+    def assignment_average(self, assignment_name: str) -> float | None:
+        """Average percentage on one assignment across students who have a score."""
+        self._get_assignment(assignment_name)
+        assignment = self._assignments[assignment_name]
+        values = [
+            scores[assignment_name]
+            for scores in self._scores.values()
+            if scores.get(assignment_name) is not None
+        ]
+        if not values:
+            return None
+        return round(sum(values) / (len(values) * assignment.max_points) * 100, 2)
+
+    def missing_scores(self, assignment_name: str) -> list[Student]:
+        """Students with no score recorded for the given assignment."""
+        self._get_assignment(assignment_name)
+        return [
+            s
+            for s in self.students()
+            if self._scores[s.student_id].get(assignment_name) is None
+        ]
+
+    # --- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _get_student(self, student_id: str) -> Student:
+        try:
+            return self._students[student_id]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise KeyError(f"no student with id {student_id!r}") from None
+
+    def _get_assignment(self, name: str) -> Assignment:
+        try:
+            return self._assignments[name]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise KeyError(f"no assignment named {name!r}") from None

+        prog="notes", description="A simple command-line notes app."

+        "--file",
+        type=Path,
+        default=None,
+        help="path to the notes file (default: $NOTES_FILE or ~/.notes.json)",

+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

+    p.add_argument("text", help="note text")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note in full")
+    p.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("edit", help="replace the text of a note")
+    p.add_argument("id", type=int)
+    p.add_argument("text")
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    p.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p = sub.add_parser("search", help="find notes containing a substring")
+    p.add_argument("query")
+

+    store = NotesStore(path)

+            if not notes:

+"""Note storage backed by a JSON file."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note ID does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    text: str
+    created: str
+    updated: str
+
+
+def default_path() -> Path:
+    """Location of the notes file; override with the NOTES_FILE env var."""
+    env = os.environ.get("NOTES_FILE")
+    if env:
+        return Path(env)
+    return Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+
+
+def _now() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
+
+
+class NotesStore:
+    """A collection of notes persisted to a single JSON file."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: Path | str):
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    # -- persistence -------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open(encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: list[Note]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        # Write atomically so a crash mid-write cannot corrupt the file.
+        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=self.path.parent, prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                json.dump([asdict(n) for n in notes], fh, indent=2)
+            os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+        except BaseException:
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                os.unlink(tmp)
+            raise
+
+    # -- operations --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def list(self) -> list[Note]:
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def add(self, text: str) -> Note:
+        text = text.strip()
+        if not text:
+            raise ValueError("note text must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        now = _now()
+        note = Note(id=next_id, text=text, created=now, updated=now)
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def edit(self, note_id: int, text: str) -> Note:
+        text = text.strip()
+        if not text:
+            raise ValueError("note text must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        for note in notes:
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                note.text = text
+                note.updated = _now()
+                self._save(notes)
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        notes = self._load()
+        for i, note in enumerate(notes):
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                removed = notes.pop(i)
+                self._save(notes)
+                return removed
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        needle = query.lower()
+        return [n for n in self.list() if needle in n.text.lower()]

+"""Storage and operations for notes, persisted as JSON."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note ID does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Note:
+    """A single note with its ID, text and creation timestamp."""
+
+    id: int
+    text: str
+    created: str  # ISO 8601, UTC
+
+
+class NotesStore:
+    """A collection of notes saved to a single JSON file."""
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: list[Note]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        tmp = self.path.with_suffix(self.path.suffix + ".tmp")
+        with tmp.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            json.dump([asdict(n) for n in notes], fh, indent=2)
+        os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+
+    def add(self, text: str) -> Note:
+        """Add a note with the given text; raise ValueError if blank."""
+        text = text.strip()
+        if not text:
+            raise ValueError("note text must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        note = Note(
+            id=next_id,
+            text=text,
+            created=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
+        )
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def list(self) -> list[Note]:
+        """Return all notes in insertion order."""
+        return self._load()
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        """Return the note with the given ID; raise if it is absent."""
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        """Delete and return the note with the given ID; raise if absent."""
+        notes = self._load()
+        for i, note in enumerate(notes):
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                del notes[i]
+                self._save(notes)
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        """Return notes whose text contains query, ignoring case."""
+        needle = query.casefold()
+        return [n for n in self._load() if needle in n.text.casefold()]

+        del self.assignments[assignment_id]
+        for student_scores in self.scores.values():
+            student_scores.pop(assignment_id, None)
+
+    # ----- scores ------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def record_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str, points: float) -> None:
+        """Record (or overwrite) a student's points on an assignment."""
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        assignment = self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        if points < 0:
+            raise ValidationError("points must not be negative")
+        if points > assignment.max_points:
+            raise ValidationError(
+                f"points ({points}) exceed max_points "
+                f"({assignment.max_points}) "
+                f"for {assignment_id!r}"
+            )
+        self.scores[student_id][assignment_id] = float(points)
+
+    def clear_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str) -> None:
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        self.scores[student_id].pop(assignment_id, None)
+
+    def get_score(self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str) -> float | None:
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        self._require_assignment(assignment_id)
+        return self.scores[student_id].get(assignment_id)
+
+    # ----- grades ------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def assignment_percent(self, student_id: str, assignment_id: str) -> float | None:
+        """Percentage on one assignment, or None if no score is recorded."""
+        points = self.get_score(student_id, assignment_id)
+        if points is None:
+            return None
+        return points / self.assignments[assignment_id].max_points * 100.0
+
+    def course_grade(self, student_id: str) -> float | None:
+        """Weighted percentage over scored assignments, None if none scored."""
+        self._require_student(student_id)
+        total_weight = 0.0
+        weighted_sum = 0.0
+        for assignment_id, points in self.scores[student_id].items():
+            assignment = self.assignments[assignment_id]
+            percent = points / assignment.max_points * 100.0
+            weighted_sum += percent * assignment.weight
+            total_weight += assignment.weight
+        if total_weight == 0:
+            return None
+        return weighted_sum / total_weight
+
+    def letter_grade(
+        self,
+        student_id: str,
+        scale: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = DEFAULT_GRADE_SCALE,
+    ) -> str | None:
+        """Letter grade for the course grade, or None if not graded."""
+        percent = self.course_grade(student_id)
+        if percent is None:
+            return None
+        return letter_for_percent(percent, scale)
+
+    def class_average(self) -> float | None:
+        """Mean of course grades across students who have at least one score."""
+        grades = []
+        for sid in self.students:
+            grade = self.course_grade(sid)
+            if grade is not None:
+                grades.append(grade)
+        if not grades:
+            return None
+        return sum(grades) / len(grades)
+
+    def report(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
+        """One row per student with their course grade and letter grade."""
+        rows = []
+        ordered = sorted(self.students.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1].name)
+        for sid, student in ordered:
+            rows.append(
+                {
+                    "student_id": sid,
+                    "name": student.name,
+                    "percent": self.course_grade(sid),
+                    "letter": self.letter_grade(sid),
+                }
+            )
+        return rows
+
+    # ----- helpers -----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _require_student(self, student_id: str) -> Student:
+        try:
+            return self.students[student_id]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise NotFoundError(f"unknown student: {student_id!r}") from None
+
+    def _require_assignment(self, assignment_id: str) -> Assignment:
+        try:
+            return self.assignments[assignment_id]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise NotFoundError(f"unknown assignment: {assignment_id!r}") from None
+
+
+def letter_for_percent(
+    percent: float,
+    scale: tuple[tuple[float, str], ...] = DEFAULT_GRADE_SCALE,
+) -> str:
+    """Map a percentage to a letter using a scale of (minimum, letter) pairs."""
+    ordered = sorted(scale, key=lambda pair: pair[0], reverse=True)
+    for minimum, letter in ordered:
+        if percent >= minimum:
+            return letter
+    raise ValidationError(f"no letter grade covers {percent}%")

+"""Command-line interface for the notes app."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TextIO
+
+from app.notes import Note, NoteNotFoundError, NotesStore
+
+DEFAULT_PATH = Path.home() / ".notes.json"
+ENV_VAR = "NOTES_FILE"
+
+
+def default_store_path() -> Path:
+    env = os.environ.get(ENV_VAR)
+    return Path(env) if env else DEFAULT_PATH
+
+
+def _format_note_line(note: Note) -> str:
+    return f"{note.id}\t{note.created_at}\t{note.title}"
+
+
+def _format_note_full(note: Note) -> str:
+    lines = [f"#{note.id} {note.title}", f"created: {note.created_at}"]
+    if note.body:
+        lines += ["", note.body]
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="notes", description="A tiny command-line notes app."
+    )
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--file",
+        type=Path,
+        default=None,
+        help=f"path to the notes file (default: ${ENV_VAR} or {DEFAULT_PATH})",
+    )
+    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+
+    p_add = sub.add_parser("add", help="add a new note")
+    p_add.add_argument("title", help="note title")
+    p_add.add_argument("-b", "--body", default="", help="note body text")
+
+    sub.add_parser("list", help="list all notes")
+
+    p_show = sub.add_parser("show", help="show a note")
+    p_show.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_del = sub.add_parser("delete", help="delete a note")
+    p_del.add_argument("id", type=int)
+
+    p_search = sub.add_parser("search", help="search titles and bodies")
+    p_search.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def main(
+    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
+    *,
+    stdout: TextIO | None = None,
+    stderr: TextIO | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    out = stdout if stdout is not None else sys.stdout
+    err = stderr if stderr is not None else sys.stderr
+    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
+
+    path = args.file if args.file is not None else default_store_path()
+    store = NotesStore(path)
+
+    try:
+        if args.command == "add":
+            note = store.add(args.title, args.body)
+            print(f"added note {note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "list":
+            notes = store.list()
+            if not notes:
+                print("no notes", file=out)
+            for note in notes:
+                print(_format_note_line(note), file=out)
+        elif args.command == "show":
+            print(_format_note_full(store.get(args.id)), file=out)
+        elif args.command == "delete":
+            note = store.delete(args.id)
+            print(f"deleted note {note.id}", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "search":
+            matches = store.search(args.query)
+            if not matches:
+                print("no matches", file=out)
+            for note in matches:
+                print(_format_note_line(note), file=out)
+    except NoteNotFoundError as exc:
+        print(f"error: no note with id {exc.args[0]}", file=err)
+        return 1
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: no cover
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Storage layer for the notes app: a list of notes persisted as JSON."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import tempfile
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note id does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str
+    created_at: str
+
+    def matches(self, query: str) -> bool:
+        q = query.casefold()
+        return q in self.title.casefold() or q in self.body.casefold()
+
+
+class NotesStore:
+    """A collection of notes backed by a JSON file.
+
+    The file is created on first write. Missing files are treated as empty.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    # -- persistence -----------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        with self.path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+            raw = json.load(fh)
+        return [Note(**item) for item in raw]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: list[Note]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        # Write atomically so a crash mid-write cannot corrupt the store.
+        fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(
+            dir=self.path.parent, prefix=".notes-", suffix=".tmp"
+        )
+        try:
+            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                json.dump([asdict(n) for n in notes], fh, indent=2)
+                fh.write("\n")
+            os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+        except BaseException:
+            if os.path.exists(tmp):
+                os.unlink(tmp)
+            raise
+
+    # -- operations ------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add(self, title: str, body: str = "") -> Note:
+        title = title.strip()
+        if not title:
+            raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        note = Note(
+            id=next_id,
+            title=title,
+            body=body,
+            created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
+        )
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def list(self) -> list[Note]:
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        notes = self._load()
+        for i, note in enumerate(notes):
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                del notes[i]
+                self._save(notes)
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        return [n for n in self.list() if n.matches(query)]

+    p_search = sub.add_parser("search", help="search titles and bodies")
+    p_search.add_argument("query")
+
+    return parser
+
+
+def _format_note_line(note: Note) -> str:
+    return f"{note.id}\t{note.title}"
+
+
+def _format_note_full(note: Note) -> str:
+    return f"#{note.id} {note.title}\n{note.created_at}\n\n{note.body}".rstrip() + "\n"
+
+
+def run(
+    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
+    *,
+    out: TextIO | None = None,
+    err: TextIO | None = None,
+) -> int:
+    """Run the CLI. Returns a process exit code."""
+    out = out if out is not None else sys.stdout
+    err = err if err is not None else sys.stderr
+    parser = build_parser()
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    path = args.file if args.file is not None else default_notes_path()
+    store = NoteStore(path)
+
+    try:
+        if args.command == "add":
+            note = store.add(args.title, args.body)
+            print(f"Added note {note.id}.", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "list":
+            notes = store.list()
+            if not notes:
+                print("No notes.", file=out)
+            for note in notes:
+                print(_format_note_line(note), file=out)
+        elif args.command == "show":
+            print(_format_note_full(store.get(args.id)), end="", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "delete":
+            note = store.delete(args.id)
+            print(f"Deleted note {note.id}.", file=out)
+        elif args.command == "search":
+            results = store.search(args.query)
+            if not results:
+                print("No matches.", file=out)
+            for note in results:
+                print(_format_note_line(note), file=out)
+        else:  # pragma: no cover - argparse enforces choices
+            parser.error(f"unknown command: {args.command}")
+    except NoteNotFoundError:
+        print(f"error: no note with id {args.id}", file=err)
+        return 1
+    except ValueError as exc:
+        print(f"error: {exc}", file=err)
+        return 2
+    return 0
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    sys.exit(run())

+"""JSON-file-backed storage for notes."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+class NoteNotFoundError(KeyError):
+    """Raised when a note id does not exist."""
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Note:
+    id: int
+    title: str
+    body: str
+    created_at: str
+
+    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
+        return asdict(self)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_dict(cls, data: dict) -> "Note":
+        return cls(
+            id=int(data["id"]),
+            title=str(data["title"]),
+            body=str(data.get("body", "")),
+            created_at=str(data["created_at"]),
+        )
+
+
+class NoteStore:
+    """Stores notes in a single JSON file.
+
+    The file is created lazily on the first write. A missing file is treated
+    as an empty store.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
+        self.path = Path(path)
+
+    # -- persistence -------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def _load(self) -> list[Note]:
+        if not self.path.exists():
+            return []
+        raw = self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
+        if not raw:
+            return []
+        data = json.loads(raw)
+        return [Note.from_dict(item) for item in data["notes"]]
+
+    def _save(self, notes: list[Note]) -> None:
+        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        payload = {"notes": [n.to_dict() for n in notes]}
+        tmp = self.path.with_suffix(self.path.suffix + ".tmp")
+        tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        os.replace(tmp, self.path)
+
+    # -- operations --------------------------------------------------------
+
+    def add(self, title: str, body: str = "") -> Note:
+        title = title.strip()
+        if not title:
+            raise ValueError("title must not be empty")
+        notes = self._load()
+        next_id = max((n.id for n in notes), default=0) + 1
+        note = Note(
+            id=next_id,
+            title=title,
+            body=body,
+            created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
+        )
+        notes.append(note)
+        self._save(notes)
+        return note
+
+    def list(self) -> list[Note]:
+        return sorted(self._load(), key=lambda n: n.id)
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        for note in self._load():
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                return note
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> Note:
+        notes = self._load()
+        for i, note in enumerate(notes):
+            if note.id == note_id:
+                removed = notes.pop(i)
+                self._save(notes)
+                return removed
+        raise NoteNotFoundError(note_id)
+
+    def search(self, query: str) -> list[Note]:
+        needle = query.lower()
+        return [
+            n
+            for n in self.list()
+            if needle in n.title.lower() or needle in n.body.lower()
+        ]
